releases.summary: Search moved to the incremental index and the export formats are named.
Table density and cross-page row selection landed on every listing.
Connectors took their own page and their callbacks now retry.
Dark theme tokens and the workspace audit trail.
The first release cut from the changelog itself.

entries.title: Search reads the incremental index
entries.body: Search answers from the incremental index, so a workspace holding a hundred thousand records returns in under a second. The old index is dropped on first boot.

entries.title: Export formats are named
entries.body: CSV, JSON and Parquet each carry a name and a description in the export dialog instead of a bare file extension.

entries.title: Dense tables
entries.body: Every listing takes a density control. Dense drops the row height from 34 to 28 pixels and holds the header row at 32.

entries.title: Selection survives a page step
entries.body: A listing keeps its selection across pages. The count in the toolbar reports the whole selection, not the page.

entries.title: Connector settings moved
entries.body: Connectors have a page of their own. The settings page keeps the workspace, the members and the billing.

entries.title: OAuth callbacks retry
entries.body: A callback that fails on a provider timeout retries three times before the connection is marked failed.

entries.title: Dark theme tokens
entries.body: Every surface reads its colour from a token, so the theme switch no longer leaves a light border on a dark ground.

entries.title: Audit trail
entries.body: Every mutation records the member, the verb and the object it acted on. The trail reads from the workspace settings.

entries.title: Changelog
entries.body: Releases are published here with their entries and tags. A release is cut on the last working day of the fortnight.

entries.title: Keyboard navigation
entries.body: Arrow keys move between rows in a listing and Enter opens the focused row.
